payload.rebuttal: fixed: _parse_admission_block only regex-parsed the per-layer threshold lines and the total line, never the header line, so a header hardcoded to the real-default shares and review cap (25%, 25%, $8.00) would have passed both the real-value test and the patched-constants run undetected. I added an assertion in _parse_admission_block that computes the expected header from cli._stack_admission_shares(1.0) and spec_review.SPEC_REVIEW_SESSION_USD, read live at call time, and compares it against lines[0]. I verified the fix by hand-applying the exact mutant described (hardcoding the header string) and confirmed it now fails specifically on the patched-constants run with a 25%/25%/$8.00 vs 38%/38%/$3.00 mismatch, then restored the real file and reran the full test suite plus the structure, dead, types and prose gates, all passing with no new prose hits.
